why: The small inside shape of each figure becomes the big outside shape of the next figure: square with circle, circle with house shape (pentagon), then pentagon with ?, then triangle with square. So C must be a pentagon with a triangle inside (the triangle is the outer shape of D). That is option 2. Option 3 has a triangle inside a square, but the outer shape must be the pentagon.
trick: In chain series, the inner shape of one figure is the outer shape of the next; check both ends of the chain.
